color_palette.text_gradient: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-400 via-pink-400 to-amber-400

global_rules: Use React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion for all animations.
Import the requested fonts (Outfit and Manrope) in the CSS or HTML.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements for robust testing.
For distribution platforms (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Amazon), use `react-icons/si` (SiSpotify, SiApplemusic, SiYoutube, SiTiktok, SiInstagram, SiAmazon).

sections.navbar: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10). Include SunoDistro logo, links, and Login/Register CTA buttons pointing to provided URLs.
sections.hero: Include a React Three Fiber canvas for 3D elements (music particles, floating waveforms) behind the main text. Use `media_urls.hero_texture` as a fallback or ambient background. Cinematic typography for headline (use text_gradient). Buttons should point to registration and AI studio.
sections.ai_music_generator: Showcase 7 genre cards (Pop, Rap, Bollywood, Punjabi, EDM, Lo-fi, Rock) using the provided `media_urls.genre_covers`. Include a mockup of a 'prompt-to-song' input field.
sections.ai_lyrics_generator: Split layout. Left side: Marketing copy. Right side: A code/text editor UI displaying live-typing lyrics animation using Framer Motion.
sections.ai_studio: Use `media_urls.ai_studio_visual`. Overlay UI elements indicating vocal isolation, mastering, and stem extraction. Glowing aesthetic.
sections.global_distribution: Display an animated world map (SVG points/dots or lines). Surround it with logos of major platforms from `react-icons/si`.
sections.features_grid: 12-card bento grid. Each card should have `layout_and_spacing.glass_card` classes, a Lucide icon, title, and description. Implement holographic hover effect using Framer Motion or Tailwind gradients.
sections.creator_dashboard: Center the `media_urls.dashboard_mockup` image. Wrap it in a styled browser/app frame with a soft sunset glow behind it to emphasize 'premium analytics'.
sections.pricing: 3 cards. Artist ($20/yr), Label ($50/yr), Ultimate ($55/yr). The Ultimate plan must be visually highlighted (scaled up slightly, gradient border, glow effect).
sections.testimonials: Use `media_urls.testimonials` portraits. Display in a grid or flex layout with premium typography for quotes.
sections.final_cta: Massive typography, gradient background overlay, and bold CTA buttons linking to the provided URLs.
sections.footer: Large brand presence, links, social icons, and copyright text.
